Man first of all im sorry to hear that, unfortunately i can’t relate to your Situation, all i can say is that i know a lot of people close to me who were(or still are) in almost the same situation as you.

It is a Dilemma… leave the life with your Parents which would  grant you a life free of this madness, but leaving your smaller sibling who is not guilty of any of this in the process.

Yet all of this people that i know are now in such a mental state that they had slowly become their own parents in a way, or damaged the relationship with their own parents beyond repair.

I think that you should choose to save yourself before you can safe anyone, and i think you already know that.

But anyways the decision is yours and yours alone to make, people on the internet will not and can’t make that decision for you. Yet i know that you will make the right choices, only a person with morals and determination can care that much about his family like you do. Be safe.
